name: Transient Synovitis of the Hip
definition: Self-limited sterile inflammation of the hip joint, usually in young children and often following a viral illness.

investigations.principle: Diagnosis is clinical after excluding serious causes; ultrasound and labs are used according to septic-arthritis risk.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, labral, tendon, ligament, infection, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Failure to improve or development of fever requires urgent reassessment for septic arthritis or other pathology.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Balaka Shroni-Shotha phenotype may be documented only after modern exclusion of infection.

patientEducation.summary: Self-limited sterile inflammation of the hip joint, usually in young children and often following a viral illness.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, rapidly progressive weakness, suspected serious infection, airway/vascular symptoms, unreduced dislocation or other listed red flags.
